notes.title: Workshop integration now available!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that you can now play and create level packs for other players using the Steam Workshop!

We also released a small level pack named [b]Downfall[/b] which you can try out right now!

If you want to learn how to make levels, check out the level editor guide in the Guides section. Help us improve this guide by asking us questions!

To try out [b]Downfall[/b] (or any other level pack) simply subscribe to it, start the game launcher, and select the levelpack in the "Level Packs" section.

We are looking forward to seeing your content!
